notes.title: QFM Patch Update Ver. 3.1 Beta
notes.content:
A quick update that fixes a little bug. In the "BOULDERS." level, upon death, the screen would reset to a 3D view, not allowing the player to move or go back to the menu.

But we know none of you experienced this bug, as none of you have ever died in The Quest for Moe's... right?

notes.title: The Quest for Moe's "Sand n' Snow" Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34020473/87ac16b4b80bafe6133fbe628b30e17cb5760ec9.png[/img]

The Quest for Moe's has received it's first update, the "Sand n' Snow" update! Explore two new areas, the Ruined Desert and the Frigid Falls! Discover more about the mysterious Rift! Meet new friends... or foes? All while collecting more queso!

This update includes the addition of both area two and area three for you to enjoy!

Details:
[list]
[*] Added area 2, the Ruined Desert
[*] Added area 3, the Frigid Falls
[*] Added two new major characters
[*] Added two new boss fights
[*] Added a dialogue skip option (z)
[*] Fixed a few dialogue errors, but it's still buggy, so please notify us of issues
[*] Tweaked colors to get rid of unwanted dull effect
[*] Animated world map
[*] And a few more surprises!
[/list]

We truly hope you will enjoy this update and be satisfied with all the melted desert queso and frozen icelands queso you find!
